Write the cleaning script that recodes 999 sentinel values to NA, harmonizes the sex coding, and drops duplicate encounter rows in data/raw/w2.parquet - I already ran QA and know what's wrong.

I just finished fitting the logistic model in analysis/models/primary.R. Do a quick sanity check on effect direction, leakage, and whether the N in the output matches the cohort before I mark the step done.
Validate our heart failure phenotype definition - check the ICD-10 code list against published definitions and compare the prevalence and age distribution to what the literature reports.
Draft the statistical analysis plan for the readmission study now that the data profile is done - primary outcome readmit_30d, mixed-effects logistic with hospital random intercept.
Figure out the multiple imputation strategy for the missing BMI and smoking variables - MICE vs complete case, how many imputations, and how to pool the estimates in the primary model.
Write the PySpark notebook in our Fabric lakehouse that reads bronze.encounters, dedupes on encounter_id, and writes silver.encounters as a Delta table.
